predictions.rationale: Directly maps behavioral features to State Diagrams inside the Explorer view; explicitly contains "StateDiagram" in its name, indicating core navigation/support for the State Diagram feature.
Connects UML StateMachine model elements to their diagram representations, which is fundamental for displaying and managing State Diagrams.
Provides UML-specific notation (textual rendering) for State bodies, a key visual element of State Diagrams.
Handles UML notation for Transitions, another central construct in State Diagrams, thus directly supporting their rendering.
Generic (language-independent) provider for State body notation; underpins how states are displayed across different notations.
Abstract/generic notation support for transitions; forms the base for concrete UML transition rendering in State Diagrams.
Navigational rule that reveals individual States within a StateMachine; aids users in exploring State Diagram structure.
Provides navigation from a StateMachine to its Transitions, supporting detailed inspection and editing of State Diagrams.
Handles traversal from composite states to their substates (subvertices), a common operation when working with hierarchical State Diagrams.
Explorer rule linking a Transition to its target State; contributes to managing and visualizing relationships within State Diagrams.
